lead: `nv verify` can fail its conformance step with every case passed.
body: `recordCases` in `tools/nv/select/record.ts` marks a case red when its coverage record is missing as well as when it fails, and under a full parallel run a record or a socket case can be lost intermittently. Run the step's cases under `nvs test --record <dir>` to see whether each one is recorded and passes, then run `bun nv verify` again: it re-runs only the reds, and a second green run means the first red was intermittent.
